INSERT INTO fgc.exception_case (exception_key, exception_type, severity, status, validation_run_id, contract_id, source_entity_type, source_entity_id, title, description) VALUES (CONCAT('ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE:', #{validationRunId}, ':ARBITRAGE_CHECK:', #{arbitrageCheckId}, ':', #{paymentStage}), 'ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE', 'HIGH', 'NEW', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, 'ARBITRAGE_CHECK', CAST(#{arbitrageCheckId} AS varchar), '차익거래 검토대상', #{description}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_exception_key DO NOTHING
